entities.summary: Raffaello da Montelupo was a sculptor and architect of the Italian Renaissance, and an apprentice of Michelangelo. He was the son of another Italian sculptor, Baccio da Montelupo. Both father and son are profiled in Vasari's Lives of the Most Excellent Painters, Sculptors, and Architects.
